children.name: Papilloderma altonagai Wiktor, R.Martin & Castillejo, 1990
children.description:
External: Spindle-shaped body; skin covered with pointed papillae; very small mantle through which shell protrudes; mantle on middle-anterior half of body; no divisions of sole (Schileyko 2003).

Internal: Flat, coiled internal shell; no jaw; long, twisted vas deferens joined slightly to the side of the penis apex; club-shaped penis containing a large verge with a coiled tip; long oviduct; very long spermatheca duct with a thick lower part; short atrium (Schileyko 2003). .
